implementation.note: Shared GameAudio sequential/cycle/window path and command reset exercised by three mixer regressions (119 checks) and actual native client PCM. Seven repeated clicks, Stop, and entity switch produced measured 440/440/660/880/440/440/660/440/440Hz output. Browser proof remains visual/input only.

architecture.note: Sequence state stays in the existing local GameAudio owner. The client forwards explicit clicks, selection changes and orders; AudioEngine owns actual playback and receives the requested variant index. No simulation state or alternate mixer added.

native_api.note: Existing onSelectionClick, resetSelectionClicks and onCommand use AudioEngine PlayParams.variant. Actual mixer tests exercise order, cycle, entity switch, command reset, explicit reset and positive timeout.

skill.note: Existing aiverse-audio recipe documents sequential/cycle/window semantics, game_file read/write and real capture rather than JSON-only acceptance. Catalog check previously validated303skills; no new skill introduced.

mcp.note: Built server registry audit passed. Actual game_file_read/write round trip on isolated project checked exact expectedText write, stale-original and invalid-JSON rejection, unchanged bytes after rejection and exact reopen/readback.

studio.note: Native WKWebView Project Data panel loads existing audio.json through shared Workspace operations. Actual UI saved count3 to4 and reread it in a new process; rejected malformed JSON retained draft. Dedicated rules/game/map owners remain separate. UI does not validate audio semantics and file saves are outside Undo.

inspector.note: Generic project text inspection/editing exposes authored audio settings without a competing audio-only store. Loaded text, dirty controls, error and discard behavior verified in native UI; JSON syntax validation is not audio semantic validation.

persistence.note: Authored JSON persists exactly through MCP reopen and native process restart; failed writes preserve saved bytes. Local click sequence is transient presentation state, intentionally not persisted in simulation saves or copied between entities.

graphs.note: This change extends scalar audio.json event-binding options. It introduces no authored graph, graph evaluator or node-editing workflow. Existing audio bank remains the data owner.

platforms.note: Native macOS actual audio callback PCM sequence verified; browser demo loads and selection clicks work, but browser audio ordering was not captured. Windows/Linux/mobile are NOT RUN. This is scoped native audio acceptance, not cross-platform sound parity.

dependencies.note: Reuses GameAudio and AudioEngine bank/variant selection; no new library, simulation dependency or platform-specific playback path.

headless.note: Repeated selection is a local presentation event; there is no server-side selection or authoritative simulation capability. Offline mixer tests exercise audio without a device, not a server feature.

examples.note: Ordinary selection-voices project contains generated PCM tones and a repeatable click/order/switch scenario. Native capture and WebGL scene/input smoke completed; browser audible ordering not measured.
